summary: Tested Tasks Module sub-tabs feature for CEO-style task management. All requested features are working correctly: My Tasks button, 4 sub-tabs (All, Tasks, Meetings, Review/Approval) with count badges, date filters (All Time, Today, This Week, This Month, Date Range), Create Task modal with 3 type options (Task, Meeting, Approval), Meeting Details section with Meeting Type, Mode, Format (Online/Offline), Meeting Link/Location fields. Sidebar correctly shows 'Business Development' instead of 'BDE Tasks'.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint not implemented. App falls back to /api/bde/tasks which works correctly.
